Import formats

Question text: Q: question on one line, A: answer on the next. CSV: question,answer headers. JSON: an array of {"question":"…","answer":"…"}. PDF and Word documents extract text. Scanned PDFs and photos use English OCR; always review the result. Older .doc files must be saved as .docx. File readers download over the internet and processing runs in your browser.
